titles.romaji: Benghuai: Xingqiong Tiedao - Taiping Lin Xin Sui
titles.english: Honkai: Star Rail - Harmony Greets the New Year
titles.native: 崩坏：星穹铁道 太平临新岁

description: A new year dawns and prosperity beckons. In a certain corner of the Exalting Sanctum, Master Gongshu and his two assistants are consumed by preparations for the Xianzhou's New Year performance.
